newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Sevel issues $70 million bond.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Sevel issues $70 million bond.

text.p: Argentine carmaker Sevel SA said Thursday it is issuing $70 million of negotiable bonds maturing next year.
The bonds, to be issued Thursday will be sold at a discount price of 91.687. The issue matures at par on Aug 26, 1997.
Citicorp Capital Markets SA will lead manage the issue, which will be listed on the Buenos Aires and Luxemboug stock exchanges.

The bond is the first issue under the carmaker's $200 million negotiable bond program approved earlier this year. The funds will be used for working capital and restructuring of liabilities, Sevel stated.
